subject: Indian History
question: Which Chinese traveller visited India during the reign of King Harshavardhana?
questionHi: राजा हर्षवर्धन के शासनकाल के दौरान कौन सा चीनी यात्री भारत आया था?
explanation: Xuanzang (Hiuen Tsang) visited India between 629–645 CE during the reign of King Harshavardhana. He attended the grand assemblies at Kannauj and Prayag in Uttar Pradesh.

subject: Indian National Movement
question: In which session did the Indian National Congress pass the famous 'Quit India' Resolution in 1942?
questionHi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस ने 1942 में प्रसिद्ध 'भारत छोड़ो' प्रस्ताव किस अधिवेशन में पारित किया था?
explanation: The Quit India Resolution was moved by Jawaharlal Nehru and ratified by the AICC at the Gowalia Tank Maidan in Bombay on 8 August 1942.

subject: Indian Constitution & Public Administration
question: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is the 'Right to Education' guaranteed as a Fundamental Right?
questionHi: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के तहत 'शिक्षा का अधिकार' मौलिक अधिकार के रूप में प्रत्याभूत है?
explanation: Article 21A was inserted by the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002, guaranteeing free and compulsory education to all children aged 6 to 14 years.

subject: Geography
question: The standard meridian of India (82°30' E) passes through which of the following places in Uttar Pradesh?
questionHi: भारत का मानक याम्योत्तर (82°30' पूर्वी देशान्तर) उत्तर प्रदेश के निम्नलिखित में से किस स्थान से होकर गुजरता है?
explanation: The standard meridian 82°30' E passes through Mirzapur (near Prayagraj, UP), which is +5:30 ahead of GMT.

subject: Indian Economy
question: The First Five-Year Plan (1951-1956) of India was based on which economic development model?
questionHi: भारत की प्रथम पंचवर्षीय योजना (1951-1956) किस आर्थिक विकास मॉडल पर आधारित थी?
explanation: The First Five-Year Plan was based on the Harrod-Domar Model, prioritizing agriculture, irrigation, and power projects.

subject: General Hindi
question: 'महोदय' शब्द का सही सन्धि-विच्छेद क्या होगा?
questionHi: 'महोदय' शब्द का सही सन्धि-विच्छेद क्या होगा?
explanation: महा + उदय = महोदय (गुण स्वर सन्धि: आ + उ = ओ).

subject: Logic & Reasoning
question: If 1st January 2006 was a Sunday, what day of the week was 1st January 2010?
questionHi: यदि 1 जनवरी 2006 को रविवार था, तो 1 जनवरी 2010 को सप्ताह का कौन सा दिन था?
explanation: Total years = 4 (2006, 2007, 2008, 2009). 2008 is a leap year (2 odd days); 2006, 2007, 2009 are normal years (1 odd day each). Total odd days = 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 5 odd days. Sunday + 5 days = Friday.

subject: General Awareness
question: Where is the headquarters of the International Court of Justice (ICJ) situated?
questionHi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय न्यायालय (ICJ) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
explanation: The International Court of Justice (ICJ) is situated at the Peace Palace in The Hague, Netherlands.

subject: UP GK
question: Which is the only National Park situated in the state of Uttar Pradesh?
questionHi: उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य में स्थित एकमात्र राष्ट्रीय उद्यान कौन सा है?
explanation: Dudhwa National Park in Lakhimpur Kheri district is the only National Park in UP (notified in 1977).
